scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 01 做事：do 与 make
prompt_en: Describe chores work and things you create or decide.
prompt_zh: 描述日常事务、工作以及创造或决定出来的结果。
description: 区分 do 的活动过程与 make 的产出结果并掌握高频固定搭配。
knowledge_points: do; make; collocations; activity versus result

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 02 获得与变化：get
prompt_en: Use get for receiving obtaining arriving and changing states.
prompt_zh: 用 get 表达收到、获得、到达和状态变化。
description: 建立 get 的核心概念并理解 get to、get from、get + adjective 和常见小品词。
knowledge_points: get; obtain; become; arrive; phrasal verbs

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 03 拿走与花费：take
prompt_en: Use take for carrying choosing consuming time and accepting.
prompt_zh: 用 take 表达拿走、选择、耗时、服用和接受。
description: 掌握 take 的移动核心与 take time、take medicine、take part 等搭配。

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 04 拥有与保持：have keep hold
prompt_en: Talk about possession experiences storage and physical control.
prompt_zh: 谈论拥有、经历、保留和手中控制。
description: 区分 have、keep、hold 并掌握 have to、keep doing、hold on。

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 05 给予与传递：give bring send show
prompt_en: Choose the right verb when something moves between people.
prompt_zh: 在物品或信息在人之间传递时选择准确动词。
description: 区分给、带来、发送和展示并练习双宾语结构。
knowledge_points: give; bring; send; show; ditransitive verbs
teaching_markdown_file: 05 给予与传递：give bring send show.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 06 说话：say tell speak talk
prompt_en: Report words tell stories and have conversations.
prompt_zh: 转述话语、讲述故事并进行交谈。
description: 根据宾语和交流方式区分 say、tell、speak、talk 及其介词。

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 07 看：look see watch read
prompt_en: Describe intentional looking noticing and watching over time.
prompt_zh: 描述主动看、自然看见、持续观看和阅读。
description: 区分 look at、see、watch、read 和 look for、look after。
knowledge_points: look; see; watch; read; visual verbs

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 08 听：hear listen sound
prompt_en: Describe hearing paying attention and impressions from sound.
prompt_zh: 描述自然听见、主动倾听和听起来的印象。
description: 区分 hear、listen to 和 sound 并练习 hear about、hear from。

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 09 来去与到达：go come arrive reach
prompt_en: Describe movement relative to the speaker and arrival at destinations.
prompt_zh: 根据说话者位置描述来去并表达抵达目的地。
description: 区分 go 与 come 以及 arrive in/at、reach、get to。
teaching_markdown_file: 09 来去与到达：go come arrive reach.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 10 放置与留下：put set leave
prompt_en: Place objects prepare arrangements and leave things behind.
prompt_zh: 放置物品、设置安排并表达把东西留下。
description: 掌握 put + 地点、set 的设置含义和 leave 的离开或保留含义。
knowledge_points: put; set; leave; placement; causative result

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 11 找与发现：find look for discover
prompt_en: Talk about searching locating and learning something new.
prompt_zh: 谈论寻找过程、找到结果和首次发现。
description: 区分 look for 的过程、find 的结果和 discover 的新发现。
teaching_markdown_file: 11 找与发现：find look for discover.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 12 学与知道：know learn study teach
prompt_en: Describe knowledge learning processes and instruction.
prompt_zh: 描述已经知道、学会过程、系统学习和教授别人。
description: 区分状态 know、获得 learn、过程 study 与传授 teach。
teaching_markdown_file: 12 学与知道：know learn study teach.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 13 想与决定：think consider decide choose
prompt_en: Express opinions reflection options and final decisions.
prompt_zh: 表达观点、认真考虑、作出决定和选择。
description: 区分 think、think about/of、consider、decide on/to 和 choose between。
teaching_markdown_file: 13 想与决定：think consider decide choose.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 14 尝试与成功：try manage practice
prompt_en: Describe attempts experiments skill practice and successful outcomes.
prompt_zh: 描述努力尝试、试试看、技能练习和最终成功。
description: 区分 try to do、try doing、manage to do 和 practice doing。
knowledge_points: try; manage; practice; gerund versus infinitive

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 15 开始继续与停止
prompt_en: Control the stages of an activity and explain interruptions.
prompt_zh: 控制活动的开始、继续、停止和完成。
description: 比较 start/begin、continue/keep、stop doing/to do 和 finish doing。
knowledge_points: start; continue; stop; finish; verb patterns

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 16 请求等待与支付：ask wait pay apply
prompt_en: Use common verbs that require for or to in practical situations.
prompt_zh: 在请求、等待、付款和申请场景中使用正确介词。
description: 掌握 ask for、ask someone to、wait for、pay for 和 apply for/to。
knowledge_points: ask for; wait for; pay for; apply for; dependent prepositions
teaching_markdown_file: 16 请求等待与支付：ask wait pay apply.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 17 关系与处理：care depend deal belong
prompt_en: Talk about concern dependence problem handling and ownership.
prompt_zh: 表达关心、依赖、问题处理和归属关系。
description: 掌握 care about/for、depend on、deal with 和 belong to。
knowledge_points: care; depend on; deal with; belong to
teaching_markdown_file: 17 关系与处理：care depend deal belong.md

scene_title: 日常动词用法：从会认到会用
title: 18 高频短语动词综合
prompt_en: Use everyday phrasal verbs with turn pick cut break take and work.
prompt_zh: 综合使用由常见动词和小品词组成的高频短语动词。
description: 理解 up、down、on、off、out 等小品词带来的方向和结果并掌握可分结构。
knowledge_points: phrasal verbs; particles; separability; integrated practice
